SECTION > LOGO
- **Brand Name:** Celsius
- **Tagline:** Experts in keeping things cool
- **Iconography:** A stylized icon consisting of three horizontal lines with curved ends, resembling wind or airflow, positioned above the brand name.

SECTION > VISUAL DESIGN
- **Background Color:** Deep Navy Blue (Solid fill)
- **Text Color:** White (for the main brand name) and Light Blue/White (for the tagline)
- **Layout:** Centered alignment on a minimalist background.
